note: Judge or human evaluates output quality. Not run in default CI. Covers the behaviors that cannot be checked structurally: stop-boundary gate, magnitude judgment, behavioral equivalence, and plan-file precondition.

cases.query: 用xc881移植这个 Go 服务到 Rust
checklist: magnitude is judged from reading the code, not assumed to be whole-project from wording
goal task locks measurable done-criteria + exit conditions before any porting is proposed
a vague boundary is raised as a blocking question, not entered as a loop
no porting action is proposed before linked req-process and cross-process artifacts exist
req-process owns scope and AC while cross-process owns only port-specific magnitude, equivalence and progress
scope, AC and done-criteria are referenced rather than duplicated across artifacts
continuation requires an explicit or unambiguous selected artifact and never scans dev-notes to guess
reads the cross-process ledger plus linked req-process current.md and current item without loading index/previous/next by default
equivalence is stated as behavioral (IO/parity/tests), not structural sameness
user-facing output explains the migration, success proof, current progress, next action and record paths in plain language
after each runnable item it checkpoints, advances and continues automatically instead of asking for continue
only explicit stepwise intent or a genuine blocker/boundary stops the run before task terminal
raw Task class/Magnitude/Stop boundary/Understanding/Equivalence headings stay in artifacts rather than the user summary
cross-process stores equivalence method and item status, while verdict/evidence stays in chat

cases.query: 用xc881迁移这个 C++ 模块到 Rust，先定边界
checklist: target project's existing architecture is preferred over transplanting the source architecture, departures recorded
idiomatic rewrite is subordinate to behavioral equivalence (correctness wins over elegance)
abstract-architectural-intent magnitude downgrades equivalence to intent fidelity only when no source code is transliterated, and marks the downgrade
skill/process porting records adopt/adapt/reject mapping before claiming intent-fidelity equivalence
delegates deep code work to $xc881-coding-skills rather than doing it inline (thin orchestrator)
a blocking decision is phrased plainly with a recommended choice and fallback or stop behavior
dev-notes creation asks the user about .gitignore, never assumes

cases.query: 将这个 Go 服务迁移到 Rust；先只判断迁移边界，不写代码
checklist: Porting remains the only active owner for the boundary outcome
classifies from supplied or cheap evidence and delegates code reading only for a blocking gap
does not create cross-process state for a small chat-only non-goal analysis
does not delegate implementation to Coding because the user explicitly requested no code

cases.query: 迁移边界已锁定，连续完成三个迁移队列项
checklist: delegates each current item to Coding and waits for checkpoint advancement before loading next
continues automatically through runnable items without per-item user prompts
stops only for explicit pause/stepwise control or a real equivalence, permission, safety or contract blocker
marks terminal only when linked requirement and porting items are complete

cases.query: 迁移中途切换模型并压缩上下文，继续保持行为等价
checklist: treats compaction as an environment event and preserves Porting as the active owner
keeps linked req current, porting item state, equivalence method, open risks and exact next action durable
reloads only the selected cross-process ledger plus linked current window
continues delegated implementation without weakening the equivalence gate or asking the user to continue
